prompt: My SKMTC project has gen-zod installed alongside my custom generator gen-api-hooks. The hooks reference the Zod schemas via `this.insertNormalizedModel(ZodProjection, { schema, fallbackName })`. I hit an ordering worry: if gen-api-hooks happens to run before gen-zod, the Zod schema Definitions won't exist yet when my constructor asks for them, and I assume the insert will fail or produce a dangling reference. How do I configure generator execution order (in client.json or wherever it lives) so gen-zod is always guaranteed to run first?

criteria.check: Did the response state that no generator execution-order configuration exists in SKMTC (no ordering, priority, or sequencing setting in client.json or anywhere else) and that none is needed?

Did the response explain create-or-reuse semantics — that `insertNormalizedModel` / `insertModel` constructs the peer's Definition on the spot when it is not yet registered, and returns the cached Definition when it is — so the dependency can never be missing?

Did the response avoid proposing ANY ordering, priority, multi-pass, or sequencing mechanism, including workarounds such as reordering the installed-generators list or splitting generation into two runs?
